purpose: Gate 3 feature cache. No model is fitted, scored or selected here.
seed_role: Recorded for provenance only. Featurisation draws no random numbers, so the cache is byte-identical on every rerun.
determinism: No run timestamp is recorded, which is what lets a rerun be byte-identical. Provenance is carried by the input checksums below.

source.structures: canonical_smiles from compounds.csv: sanitised, largest fragment, neutralised and InChIKey-verified by Gate 2. Raw SMILES are never read.

row_order: Ascending standardised full InChIKey, identical to the saved split assignment CSVs, so the cached matrices join to them positionally.

rationale.MolWt: Average molecular weight; the size term of Lipinski's rule of five.
rationale.HeavyAtomCount: Size as an integer atom count, free of hydrogen-weight and isotope conventions.
rationale.MolLogP: Crippen atom-contribution octanol/water logP; the lipophilicity term of the rule of five.
rationale.MolMR: Crippen molar refractivity; polarisability and bulk, the Ghose-filter companion to logP.
rationale.TPSA: Topological polar surface area; the polarity term of Veber's permeability rules.
rationale.NumLipinskiHBD: Lipinski hydrogen-bond donors (N-H and O-H count), the rule-of-five donor definition.
rationale.NumLipinskiHBA: Lipinski hydrogen-bond acceptors (nitrogen and oxygen count), the rule-of-five definition.
rationale.NumRotatableBonds: Conformational flexibility; the Veber rotatable-bond term.
rationale.RingCount: Number of SSSR rings; total ring content.
rationale.NumAromaticRings: Aromatic ring count; aromatic versus saturated ring character.
rationale.FractionCSP3: Fraction of sp3-hybridised carbons; saturation and three-dimensional character.
rationale.NumHeteroatoms: Heteroatom count; polar functionality that TPSA alone does not separate.

descriptor_block.selection_rule: Fixed and declared before any model is fitted. Chosen for named, monotone interpretability, not by any score.
descriptor_block.nan_inf_policy: Every descriptor value is checked with numpy.isfinite. A non-finite value is written to featurisation_failures.csv and aborts the run. Nothing is imputed, clipped or dropped, so no imputation statistic exists that could have been fitted on the full dataset.
descriptor_block.scaling_policy: None. No centring, scaling, variance filtering or feature selection is applied at Gate 3. The descriptor baseline is a tree ensemble, which is invariant to monotone per-column rescaling, so a scaler would add a fitted object with no benefit. Any transform a later gate adds must be fitted on training rows only.
descriptor_block.statelessness: Provably stateless: each row is a function of one molecule alone. No row, label, split or dataset-level statistic enters another row's features. test_features.py checks this by featurising single molecules in isolation.
descriptor_block.omitted_aliphatic_ring_count: NumAliphaticRings is deliberately omitted: RDKit partitions SSSR rings into aromatic and aliphatic, so it is exactly RingCount - NumAromaticRings. The identity is measured, not assumed; see collinearity.aliphatic_ring_identity_max_deviation.

fingerprint_block.storage: numpy.packbits along the bit axis; load_features unpacks it.
fingerprint_block.bit_length_justification: 2,048 bits is inherited unchanged from the Gate 2 similarity audit and leakage probe, so the audited near-duplicate and shared-core counts describe this model's actual input space. It was not chosen by any metric; folding_evidence records what it costs.

collinearity.note: Computed on each split's training rows only, with no label involved, and used for nothing. Reported so a Gate 4 interpretation cannot mistake two near-duplicate columns for independent evidence.

disclaimer: Literature/patent-reported IC50; no efficacy, safety or suitability claim.
